I’m tightening the simulator defaults loader so it reads the properties file once instead of twice. That keeps the code simple and avoids duplicate file I/O during class initialization.
I’ve finished the code wiring for the external UI/default configs. I’m compiling now to catch any property-key, import, or initialization issues before wrapping up.
